card.name: Colon between hour and minutes
card.fires_on: The colon right after the hour digits in a clock time within a web post timestamp, such as forum, blog or revision dates.

modes.label: Forum timestamp
modes.description: Colon after the hour in a date-plus-time stamp beside a username or view link.

modes.label: Blog or article byline time
modes.description: Colon after the hour in a posted-on line, often followed by AM or PM.

card.plain: It marks the colon that separates hours from minutes in a time stamp on a web page.
